messages:
Alex Kim: Heads up — AcmeSearch just escalated. Their rerank results are nonsensical after a client deploy. They were sending 64-dim vectors into our reranker which expects 768.

Alex Kim: Example request they sent:
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "reranker_model": "redwood/rerank-base-768",
  "query_vector": [ /* length 64 */ 0,0,0, ... ],
  "candidate_vectors": [[ /* length 64 */ 0,0,0, ... ], ... ]
}
```

Alex Kim: Server returned 200 but scores were all ~-100 and ordering was wrong. No 4xx to explain the client mistake. Customer hit prod, pretty urgent.

Maria Gonzales: Did they call our embed endpoint or a third-party embedder? @Alex Kim

Alex Kim: They used our embed endpoint but selected openembed-tiny in the client config. So dims=64.

Jordan Lee: Ugh. We should be validating dimensions server-side. Right now the matmul proceeds or we coerce silently. Not good.

SRE Bot: system: rerank-prod-01 logged large matmul mismatch errors at 2024-06-07T14:05:10Z, elevated CPU on the GPU host around the call.

Maria Gonzales: Quick repro I ran locally:
```bash
# produce toy 64-dim vectors
python -c "from math import *; import json; print(json.dumps({'query_vector':[0]*64,'candidate_vectors':[[0]*64]*3,'reranker_model':'redwood/rerank-base-768'}))" > /tmp/payload.json
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @/tmp/payload.json
# response: 200 with weird identical/very low scores
```

Maria Gonzales: Repro is deterministic.

Support Liaison: Customer is asking for immediate remediation. They prefer a server-side fix rather than having clients roll back.

Jordan Lee: Short-term plan: patch the rerank handler to validate vector lengths against the model profile and return 400 with a clear message when mismatched. Suggested message: "embedding dimension 64 incompatible with reranker model expecting 768. Use [embed model X] or change reranker to compatible model."

ops-oncall: I can push a small validation to canary in 10 minutes. What exact payload field should we check? query_vector length and candidate_vectors inner length?

Maria Gonzales: Yes — check both. Also log the model names and add a telemetry event embed_dim_mismatch with counts.

SRE Bot: system: created ticket INC-2024-2458 for embed_dim_mismatch telemetry and rerank validation.

Alex Kim: I'll draft an email to AcmeSearch with repro steps and the recommended temporary workaround (rollback client to previous embed model).

Support Liaison: Customer accepted rollback for now, wants ETA for server fix.

Jordan Lee: I'll add a unit/integration test to catch this (mismatched dims -> 400). Also adding guidance in SDK to warn when model pairs look incompatible.

ops-oncall: Deploying canary with validation check to rerank-prod-canary now. Rolling back quickly if anything odd. :rocket:

Alex Kim: Thanks. After canary, we should push canary telemetry dashboard and a short runbook for CS.

Maria Gonzales: Also consider a mapping table in model catalog that lists compatible embed <-> reranker pairs and surface warnings in the Console.

ops-oncall: Canary in progress. Will report back with results within 15m.

Alex Kim: (reacts :eyes:)

Maria Gonzales: Nice work team.
